title: Phase 5 - Notifications and workflow polish
description: Add workspace-scoped notifications, status badges, focus return, and workflow polish so parallel work stays manageable.

title: P5-001 Notification domain service
description: Create the workspace-scoped notification service and store instead of handling notifications ad hoc.
acceptance_criteria: Notifications can be created, marked read, and dismissed; each links to a workspace and optional job.
close_reason: Not needed — ManagedAgentPane=chat, activity service=jobs, badges=notifications

title: P5-002 Toast notification renderer
description: Render in-app toast notifications for relevant job completion and failure events.
acceptance_criteria: Toasts appear on relevant job events and clicking a toast can focus the workspace.
close_reason: Not needed — ManagedAgentPane=chat, activity service=jobs, badges=notifications

title: P5-003 Notification inbox / history pane
description: Add a durable notification history surface so toasts do not disappear into the void.
acceptance_criteria: Users can review older notifications and read/unread state works.
close_reason: Not needed — ManagedAgentPane=chat, activity service=jobs, badges=notifications

title: P5-004 Workspace status badge wiring
description: Wire real running, failure, and attention-needed state into workspace badges in sidebar and overview.
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar and overview badges update live from real runtime state.

title: P5-005 Job completion focus action
description: Make job notifications actionable by restoring the relevant workspace and pane context.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking a completion event restores the target workspace and focuses the relevant pane where possible.
close_reason: Not needed — ManagedAgentPane=chat, activity service=jobs, badges=notifications

title: Per-turn diff viewer for managed agent sessions
description: Show unified/split diffs per agent turn in managed agent sessions, so users can see exactly what the agent changed at each step. Inspired by t3code's per-turn diff viewer. Higher value than embedded editor — surfaces agent changes inline without leaving the pane.

title: Fix workspace and pane camera model regression
description: Current shell mixes workspace camera, pane strip navigation, and top-level split layout. Result: workspaces/surfaces bleed into each other and add-pane mutates layout semantics instead of pure navigation. Clean up the navigation/layout boundary so the active workspace and active pane destination own the viewport.
acceptance_criteria: Active workspace fully owns the main region with no adjacent workspace bleed. Adding a pane creates a full-size navigable destination without collapsing the previous one into view. Explicit splits remain contained to the active destination only. Electron coverage proves no visible spill for workspace or pane transitions.

title: Direct Git project import and worktree-backed workspaces
description: Replace the metadata-only project/workspace creation flow with Git-backed repo import and real worktree creation.
acceptance_criteria: Opening a repo imports normalized Git metadata and creates or selects the root workspace; creating an extra workspace creates a real git worktree and only persists after success; empty state shows no seeded placeholder projects by default.

title: Store app state under Electron userData with cwd migration
description: Production startup currently opens .aide.sqlite3 under process.cwd(). Launching from another directory creates a different app identity/state, and packaged launches may target an unwritable or surprising path. Migrate existing cwd databases once and use app.getPath('userData') thereafter; keep AIDE_DATABASE_PATH for tests/overrides.
acceptance_criteria: Default storage is stable across launch directories and writable in packaged builds; an existing cwd database migrates without data loss; tests cover override, first launch, migration, and conflicts.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by node, check, build, Electron E2E, relaunch, multi-project, and accessibility smoke gates.

title: Fix bun test runner split for Vitest, Playwright, and node:sqlite
description: The repo-level bun test gate currently fails for environment/config reasons unrelated to the new layout persistence work. Bun tries to execute the Playwright spec directly, and Bun does not provide node:sqlite for the main database tests. Clean up the test entrypoints so the default test command is trustworthy again.
acceptance_criteria: bun test runs the intended unit test suite without importing Playwright specs; SQLite-backed tests run in a supported runtime or are moved behind an explicit Node-only command; repo quality-gate docs/scripts reflect the intended commands.

title: tmp
description: tmp
acceptance_criteria: tmp

title: Replace managed terminal heuristics with structured Claude/Codex runtime adapters
description: Current managed terminal status is now provider-scoped and no longer misclassifies permission-mode hints, but it still relies on provider-specific terminal parsing. Follow up by integrating structured Claude/Codex runtime events so sidebar states come from provider session/activity signals instead of terminal transcript parsing.
acceptance_criteria: Managed Claude/Codex status is derived from structured provider events rather than PTY text; sidebar semantics still match Pending Approval/Awaiting Input/Working/Connecting/Completed/Error; shell terminals remain coarse only.

title: Eliminate nested interactive controls and add accessibility smoke coverage
description: Headless accessibility snapshots show buttons nested inside buttons in the model picker, pane controls, and tooltip wrappers. These invalid trees produce duplicate roles, unreliable names, and keyboard/screen-reader quirks.
acceptance_criteria: No interactive element is nested in another interactive element in core shell paths; icon buttons have stable accessible names; automated smoke coverage fails on critical accessibility/console errors.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by node, check, build, Electron E2E, relaunch, multi-project, and accessibility smoke gates.

title: Reduce renderer startup payload and lazy-load code rendering assets
description: Production build emits a 5.6 MB renderer entry plus hundreds of Shiki language/theme chunks and ~509 KB CSS. Load syntax highlighting, Monaco, icons, and heavyweight panes on demand and enforce a budget.
acceptance_criteria: Initial renderer entry is materially smaller, core shell becomes interactive without loading editor/diff assets, and CI reports or enforces agreed bundle budgets without breaking Git rendering.

title: Block reserved navigation shortcuts in terminal and autofocus on return
description: Terminal panes should not consume shell/window-management navigation chords, and returning to a terminal pane should focus the live xterm view without an extra click.
acceptance_criteria: Reserved shell shortcuts are blocked from terminal input; default Super/Meta navigation aliases are also blocked; returning to an active terminal pane focuses the terminal automatically; renderer/main tests and Electron regression coverage pass.

title: Make managed sessions durable across view and app lifecycle
description: Managed session ownership is coupled to React pane mounting, while app shutdown is fire-and-forget and asymmetric on macOS. Port the durable provider-session registry/snapshot/reaper principles from current T3 Code so renderer navigation or reload cannot accidentally terminate work and reconnect state is explicit.
acceptance_criteria: Switching views, reloading, and closing/reopening a window preserve eligible sessions; explicit pane deletion terminates them; app quit awaits bounded cleanup; stale sessions are reaped; lifecycle E2E coverage passes on supported platforms.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by node, check, build, Electron E2E, relaunch, multi-project, and accessibility smoke gates.

title: Phase 0 - Spec freeze and spikes
description: Lock product boundaries, prove the Electron/Bun/Vite stack, and establish the initial domain and persistence foundations described in docs/03-roadmap-phases.md.

title: P0-001 Create decision log and scope file
description: Prevent drift before implementation starts by creating a durable decision log and scope file from the product docs.
acceptance_criteria: Product category, core panes, stack, preview limitation, and workspace/window rules are documented; non-goals are explicit.

title: P0-002 Electron shell spike
description: Prove the desktop shell can host the app cleanly by bootstrapping Electron with React, TypeScript, Bun, Vite, and Biome.
acceptance_criteria: App launches from one command; Bun/Vite dev workflow is acceptable; IPC round trip is proven; basic dev and build scripts exist.

title: P0-003 Monaco pane spike
description: Verify Monaco can be embedded cleanly in the chosen shell as the basis for light editor use.
acceptance_criteria: Syntax highlighting works; opening file text works; no obvious blocker for theme or resize handling.

title: P0-004 xterm.js + PTY spike
description: Prove a live terminal pane is viable early with xterm.js and a PTY backend.
acceptance_criteria: Shell launches on target OS; input/output works; resize works; process can be killed.

title: P0-005 Preview spike
description: Verify the preview pane can safely load local runtime surfaces without becoming a general browser.
acceptance_criteria: Localhost page renders; reload works; a basic isolation policy is decided.

title: P0-006 Persistence spike
description: Establish a basic SQLite-backed storage layer so project and workspace state does not need to be rewritten later.
acceptance_criteria: Projects and workspaces can be stored and reloaded; a migration strategy is chosen.

title: P0-007 CLI executable resolution spike
description: Create a utility layer to find, validate, and launch external binaries for provider adapters and other CLI integrations.
acceptance_criteria: Configured executable paths resolve; validation errors are human-readable; launching a test command works.

title: P0-008 Domain schema draft
description: Draft the initial shared TypeScript domain model for projects, workspaces, layouts, panes, jobs, and notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Project, Workspace, LayoutNode, Pane, Job, and Notification types exist; obvious gaps are listed.

title: Make empty workspace scene fill the full workspace width
description: The workspace slider track did not grow to full width inside the canvas, so an empty workspace rendered as a narrow strip aligned left instead of occupying the whole scene.
acceptance_criteria: Empty workspaces render full-width inside the workspace scene; the fix does not break imported-project startup or existing navigation tests.

title: Replace provider event parsers with real Claude SDK / Codex app-server adapters
description: The workspace status path now uses canonical provider runtime events and a t3code-style projector, but the managed Claude/Codex adapters still synthesize those events from terminal output. Replace those adapters with true provider-backed event sources so Claude status comes from the Claude SDK/runtime stream and Codex status comes from codex app-server notifications/requests instead of PTY parsing.
acceptance_criteria: Managed Claude status is driven by structured Claude SDK/runtime events; managed Codex status is driven by codex app-server events; workspace/sidebar pills continue to resolve from the same projector without PTY-text heuristics for managed modes.

title: Phase 1 - App skeleton and workspace domain
description: Build the durable app shell, project/workspace storage, selection state, and sidebar foundations so workspace becomes the top-level object.

title: P1-001 App shell scaffolding
description: Create the root application frame with the permanent sidebar rail area and main content region.
acceptance_criteria: App renders without mock-only hacks; layout scales with window resize.

title: P1-010 Workspace summary model
description: Create a compact derived summary model for workspace state so sidebar and overview surfaces stay lightweight.
acceptance_criteria: Summary includes branch, status, and placeholder job count without requiring deep data pulls.

title: P1-011 Navigation shell POC
description: Build a navigation-first proof of concept with demo projects, placeholder workspace panes, and a sidebar rail that proves spatial movement before real pane depth lands.
acceptance_criteria: Hardcoded or seeded demo projects/workspaces render by default for the POC; selecting projects and workspaces drives the full main region; placeholder pane surfaces make navigation targets visible; sidebar rail supports collapsed, hover-expand, and pinned-open states.

title: P1-012 HeroUI token and surface pilot
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Bring HeroUI v3 into the renderer in a controlled way by aligning shell tokens and proving a small surface-level integration without changing the navigation model or shell geometry.

User stories covered: 3, 4, 19, 20 from `docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md`.
acceptance_criteria: HeroUI v3 coexists cleanly with the current shell stack; the shell theme exposes surface-friendly tokens; one contained pilot surface proves the visual direction; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P1-013 HeroUI shell primitive swap
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Replace the highest-value low-risk shell primitives with HeroUI v3 equivalents, focusing on buttons, badges or chips, tooltip styling, and keyboard hint treatments in the active shell.

User stories covered: 4, 5, 7, 19 from `docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md`.
acceptance_criteria: The project rail, top bar, and shell chrome use HeroUI-backed low-risk primitives where planned; the visual quality improves without changing navigation semantics; no visual regressions appear in the current shell; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P1-014 HeroUI forms for project and workspace creation
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Adopt HeroUI form primitives for project and workspace creation so setup flows feel cleaner, more intentional, and more accessible once the creation surfaces are real.

User stories covered: 8, 9, 17 from `docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Project/workspace creation flows use HeroUI text field, input, select, label, description, and field error primitives where appropriate; validation and empty-state support remain clear; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P1-002 Project repository layer
description: Implement CRUD for project metadata so projects can group workspaces and load on app start.
acceptance_criteria: Create/read/update/delete project functions exist; project list loads on app start.

title: P1-003 Workspace repository layer
description: Implement CRUD for workspaces, including window ownership, so the workspace becomes the core persisted object.
acceptance_criteria: Create/read/update/delete workspace functions exist; workspaces link to projects; window ownership is stored.

title: P1-004 Workspace creation flow
description: Build the UI flow for creating a workspace from project, branch, and worktree configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create a workspace; branch name and worktree path are stored; failures are surfaced cleanly.

title: P1-005 App boot restore
description: Restore known projects and workspaces on app launch so relaunches preserve working context.
acceptance_criteria: Relaunch restores the sidebar structure; last-selected workspace behavior is intentionally handled.

title: P1-006 Workspace selection state
description: Create a shared store for current project, workspace, and pane selection.
acceptance_criteria: Selection changes propagate in UI and persist where appropriate.

title: P1-007 Main content placeholder workspace view
description: Render a placeholder workspace landing surface before the full pane system exists.
acceptance_criteria: The selected workspace renders in the main area; the empty state is clear.

title: P1-008 Sidebar rail foundation
description: Build the permanently visible sidebar and project rail foundation for the shell, keeping the rail narrow, non-overlapping, and navigation-first while the workspace owns the rest of the window.
acceptance_criteria: Rail is always visible; it never overlaps the main region; direct project selection works from the rail; holding Ctrl reveals numeric project hints; the top bar stays compact; the selected workspace and pane own the remaining window cleanly.

title: P1-009 Project/workspace tree in sidebar
description: Render the project/workspace tree so navigation is visible before keyboard polish.
acceptance_criteria: Projects group workspaces correctly; the current workspace is obvious; placeholder badges can render.

title: Recover cleanly when a managed provider cannot start
description: ManagedSessionManager retained failed sessions and Codex app-server lacked child-process error handling. A missing executable could emit an unhandled ENOENT, hang startup until timeout, and make retry reuse a dead snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: Failed startup rejects promptly without an unhandled process error; failed sessions are removed; a second create attempt reaches the provider again; unit regressions cover generic provider failure and missing Codex executable.

title: Phase 2 - Layout, navigation, sidebar, overview shell
description: Make the app spatial and usable with the split-tree layout, focus navigation, workspace switching, sidebar polish, and overview.

title: P2-001 Layout tree schema and persistence
description: Persist a split-tree layout model per workspace so pane arrangements survive reloads.
acceptance_criteria: Horizontal, vertical, and pane leaf nodes are supported; layouts restore after relaunch.

title: P2-010 Workspace state badges
description: Add badge slots and status states so sidebar and overview can display workspace health.
acceptance_criteria: Sidebar and overview support placeholder job count, running state, and error state badges.

title: P2-011 Layout presets
description: Create common starter split layouts so users can jump into useful pane arrangements quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Applying a preset produces the intended split tree for the workspace.

title: P2-012 State repair for invalid layouts
description: Add normalization and fallback logic so malformed layout state does not brick workspace rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Bad or partial layout data falls back safely to a valid layout.

title: P2-013 HeroUI toolbar for pane indicator strip
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Rebuild the pane indicator strip with HeroUI toolbar-oriented primitives so pane navigation feels tighter, cleaner, and more intentional once pane focus behavior is stable.

User stories covered: 3, 4, 19 from `docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md`.
acceptance_criteria: The active pane indicator strip uses HeroUI toolbar-aligned components; pane focus state remains obvious; left/right pane movement semantics are unchanged; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-014 HeroUI workspace switcher overlay
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Rebuild the workspace switcher overlay with HeroUI list and overlay primitives so workspace movement feels premium, accessible, and easier to extend.

User stories covered: 10, 13, 16, 18 from `docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md`.
acceptance_criteria: The workspace switcher overlay uses HeroUI listbox/popover-like primitives where appropriate; keyboard movement and active-state affordances remain strong; the overlay feels visually cleaner than the custom placeholder version; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-015 HeroUI scroll shadows and nested surfaces
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Add HeroUI scroll-shadow and surface concepts to the pane strip and nested pane internals so movement and depth are easier to perceive without changing pane ownership rules.

User stories covered: 3, 4, 19 from `docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Horizontal pane movement gains clear scroll affordance; nested pane internals use a stronger surface hierarchy; the pane itself remains the full-region wrapper; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-016 HeroUI cleanup and shadcn reduction
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Remove obsolete shadcn wrappers and parallel styling layers after the selective HeroUI adoption tasks land, keeping only the custom shell structure plus the primitives that still pull their weight.

User stories covered: 4, 19, 20 from `docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Unused shadcn wrappers and redundant dependencies are removed where safe; the shell keeps its custom navigation architecture; the resulting UI stack is simpler and more coherent; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-017 Spatial navigation state model
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Replace the current selection-driven shell state with a resolved project->workspace->pane navigation model that supports deterministic boot restore, repair rules, and direction-aware transitions without snap-back to index 0.

User stories covered: 1, 2, 3, 4, 9, 10, 13, 14 from `docs/prd/spatial-navigation-canvas.md`.
acceptance_criteria: The shell resolves a full navigation path once at boot; project/workspace/pane state updates through one navigation model; invalid remembered state repairs deterministically; no reset-to-first-pane or reset-to-first-workspace occurs during normal movement; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-018 Horizontal pane camera track
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Make pane movement a true horizontal camera over the active workspace so exactly one pane is visible at a time, every pane is reachable, and click plus keyboard movement stay in sync.

User stories covered: 1, 5, 14, 15 from `docs/prd/spatial-navigation-canvas.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Only one pane is visible at a time; clicking any pane indicator reaches the correct pane; `Alt+Left/Right` and `Alt+h/l` move reliably; pane movement direction is visually correct; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-019 Vertical workspace camera track
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Render workspace movement as a vertical camera inside the active project so switching workspaces feels like moving up and down instead of replacing content in place.

User stories covered: 2, 4, 6, 10, 14 from `docs/prd/spatial-navigation-canvas.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace movement is visibly vertical; `Alt+Up/Down` and `Alt+j/k` work in the desktop app; workspace switcher overlay and sidebar selection target the same state model; switching workspaces updates the main region and rail together; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-002 Layout renderer
description: Render nested split trees recursively so workspace layout becomes visible.
acceptance_criteria: Nested layouts render correctly and resize stably.

title: P2-020 Project context restore chain
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Persist and restore each project's last active workspace and pane so project switches preserve spatial context instead of resetting to defaults.

User stories covered: 3, 4, 10, 11 from `docs/prd/spatial-navigation-canvas.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Project switching restores the remembered workspace and pane for that project; `Ctrl+digit` and project-rail clicks use the same restore path; switching projects never resets to workspace 0 or pane 0 unless no valid remembered target exists; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-021 Terminal session reattachment for spatial shell
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Make terminal sessions workspace/pane-owned runtime services that survive leaving a pane or workspace and reattach when the user returns.

User stories covered: 7, 8, 9 from `docs/prd/spatial-navigation-canvas.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Leaving the terminal pane does not kill the PTY; leaving and returning to the workspace reattaches the session; terminal navigation shortcuts do not get swallowed; explicit close remains the only destructive action; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and `npx -y react-doctor@latest .` pass.

title: P2-022 Electron Playwright navigation verification
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Add Electron-aware Playwright coverage for pane, workspace, and project movement so desktop regressions are caught where the browser path is insufficient.

User stories covered: 5, 6, 10, 12, 14 from `docs/prd/spatial-navigation-canvas.md`.
acceptance_criteria: Playwright covers pane 4/5 reachability, workspace switching from terminal focus, project jump restore, and no snap-back on boot or context switch in Electron; failures are actionable and artifacts are retained; `bun test`, `bun run build`, `bunx @biomejs/biome check .`, and the relevant Playwright command pass.

title: P2-023 Sidebar tree interaction polish
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Polish the new project/workspace tree so expand-collapse behavior, active-project synchronization, and keyboard accessibility feel deliberate instead of provisional.

User stories covered: 5, 7, 10, 11 from docs/prd/navigation-first-workspace-shell.md.
acceptance_criteria: The active project stays expanded; tree toggles expose clear expanded state; keyboard interaction remains usable; the tree feels stable and intentional while preserving the current navigation model; bun test, bun run build, bunx @biomejs/biome check ., and npx -y react-doctor@latest . pass.

title: P2-003 Pane placeholder system
description: Introduce pane placeholders with type badges and focus state before real pane implementations exist.
acceptance_criteria: Placeholders can represent any pane type; focus ring and selection styling exist.

title: P2-004 Split/close/resize operations
description: Implement the layout commands users need to shape a workspace: split, close, and resize.
acceptance_criteria: Panes can be split and closed without corrupting layout; last-pane protection is defined.

title: P2-005 Pane focus navigation
description: Implement pane neighbor focus rules to make left/right pane movement a real product promise.
acceptance_criteria: Alt+Left and Alt+Right work; focus state is never ambiguous; vertical behavior is defined or intentionally absent.

title: P2-006 Workspace switching shortcuts
description: Add fast keyboard switching between workspaces in the current project.
acceptance_criteria: Users can cycle workspaces; main content and sidebar update together.

title: P2-007 Ctrl-hold project jump hints
description: Implement the Ctrl-hold numeric hint overlay for direct project switching from the sidebar.
acceptance_criteria: Holding Ctrl reveals project numbers; pressing a number jumps project; releasing Ctrl hides hints.

title: P2-008 Sidebar interaction polish
description: Polish keyboard focus, hover intent, pin behavior, and selection handling for the sidebar.
acceptance_criteria: Hover does not flicker badly; keyboard access is usable; pinned-open state persists.

title: P2-009 Overview shell
description: Create the initial overview switcher for fast project and workspace jumps.
acceptance_criteria: Overview opens with a shortcut; users can jump to a workspace; current selection is obvious.

title: Use pane-strip plus for pane creation and move workspace creation to the tree
description: Repurpose the top-bar plus button from workspace creation to pane creation, including seeding the first pane into empty workspaces. Keep workspace creation available from the navigation tree instead of the pane strip.
acceptance_criteria: The top-bar plus opens pane creation; empty workspaces can seed their first pane; workspace creation is accessible from the workspace tree; existing navigation/import flows keep working.

title: Make reserved terminal shortcut blocking configurable from shortcut settings
description: The terminal now consults a shared reserved-shortcut matcher instead of hardcoding its blocked keys. Follow through by making that blocked set come from the app's future shortcut settings model rather than fixed defaults.
acceptance_criteria: Shortcut settings can define the shell-owned chords that terminal panes must not consume; terminal blocking uses the configured matcher instead of only defaults; existing default Alt navigation and overview/project-jump behavior remains intact when no custom settings exist.
close_reason: Env vars and hardcoded shortcuts sufficient for now

title: Use edge-mounted icon controls for pane chrome
description: Replace the text-heavy pane action bar with icon-only edge-mounted controls that sit half outside the active pane and reveal labels via delayed tooltips.
acceptance_criteria: Pane controls use icon buttons instead of text labels; The control rail sits on the active pane edge without consuming content space; Tooltips appear on delayed hover; Build and headless Electron navigation suite pass

title: Phase 6 - Multi-window and usability pass
description: Add detached workspace windows, ownership rules, global notification routing, and onboarding without breaking the workspace model.

title: Establish main runtime and window ownership boundary
description:
Execution mode: AFK
Extract a tested ApplicationRuntime/WindowManager boundary without changing user-visible behavior so window ownership, diagnostics, recovery, and IPC can evolve independently.
acceptance_criteria: Service lifecycle and window creation are testable through narrow interfaces; current single-window behavior and all gates remain green.

title: Detach and focus an exclusively owned workspace window
description:
Execution mode: AFK
Persist workspace ownership, detach one workspace to a dedicated window, and focus its existing owner instead of duplicating it.
acceptance_criteria: A workspace exists in one window only; detach, focus-existing, close, and ownership repair are covered in Electron E2E.

title: Reattach workspaces without terminating runtime sessions
description:
Execution mode: AFK
Transfer the workspace back to the main window while terminal/provider services survive and preview ownership reconnects without duplicate guests.
acceptance_criteria: Terminal and managed work continue through detach/reattach; preview returns at its committed URL and only the owning window presents it.

title: Restore detached windows and route global navigation
description:
Execution mode: AFK
Restore persisted bounds/ownership, repair missing displays, and route notifications/sidebar/overview/shortcuts to the owning window.
acceptance_criteria: Relaunch restores valid detached windows; invalid displays fall back safely; global actions focus the exact window, workspace, and pane.

title: Serialize workspace layout mutations
description: Pane create/split/close/resize handlers fire async persistence calls without awaiting or queueing and derive each mutation from a captured navigation snapshot. Rapid commands can complete out of order and overwrite newer layouts.
acceptance_criteria: Mutations for a workspace are ordered or revision-checked; rapid mixed operations cannot resurrect closed panes or lose splits; deterministic concurrency tests reproduce the old race and pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by node, check, build, Electron E2E, relaunch, multi-project, and accessibility smoke gates.

title: Linux production-alpha hardening
description: Complete diagnostics, recovery, security, settings, packaging, release provenance, and Linux acceptance for a controlled private alpha.
acceptance_criteria: Signed x64 AppImage and DEB artifacts pass installed-product, recovery, security, accessibility, and soak gates.

title: Deliver local crash diagnostics and redacted support bundles
description:
Execution mode: AFK
Add structured rotating local logs, main/renderer crash handling, diagnostics UI, and explicit redacted support ZIP export.
acceptance_criteria: Crashes are actionable; exported bundles contain versions and diagnostics but never prompts, terminal output, patches, credentials, environment values, or raw home paths.

title: Recover explicitly from damaged persisted state
description:
Execution mode: AFK
Add integrity checks, pre-migration and known-good backups, safe mode, and explicit restore/reset/open-folder/quit recovery choices.
acceptance_criteria: Corruption and failed migrations never silently discard data; tested recovery restores a backup or creates a backed-up reset only after explicit choice.

title: Harden Electron and IPC for offline local operation
description:
Execution mode: AFK
Bundle renderer resources, enforce CSP and sandbox boundaries, deny unsafe navigation/permissions, and validate renderer-controlled IPC inputs.
acceptance_criteria: Offline startup has no remote renderer requests; malicious navigation, webview, path, and IPC payload tests fail closed without side effects.

title: Ship synchronized settings and first-run onboarding
description:
Execution mode: AFK
Persist versioned graphics, editor, provider, notification, diagnostics, and onboarding preferences and migrate relevant renderer-local preferences.
acceptance_criteria: Settings synchronize across windows and relaunch; onboarding can import a project, create a workspace, and open core panes, and can be skipped or reset.

title: Package and smoke-test Linux x64 AppImage and DEB
description:
Execution mode: AFK
Add electron-builder packaging, desktop metadata, icons, native module rebuilds, and installed-artifact smoke tests.
acceptance_criteria: AppImage runs on the current Linux host; DEB installs, launches under Xvfb, relaunches with persisted data, and uninstalls on Ubuntu; packaged PTY works.

title: Publish reproducible signed Linux alpha artifacts
description:
Execution mode: HITL
Generate SBOM and SHA256SUMS, SSH-sign the checksum manifest and source tag, publish immutable manual release notes, and document verification.
acceptance_criteria: Version 0.1.0-alpha.1 AppImage and DEB verify against the signed manifest and are attached to the exact tested source tag; unsigned release is impossible.

title: Pass the Linux private-alpha acceptance and soak gate
description:
Execution mode: HITL
Run the complete user journey, packaged security/recovery/accessibility checks, automated stress, and manual real-provider dogfood.
acceptance_criteria: All required gates pass, no high/critical audit findings remain, no unexpected console/accessibility errors occur, and release evidence is recorded.

title: Record the Linux production-alpha PRD
description:
Execution mode: AFK
Record the locked Linux private-alpha intent, navigation, implementation, testing, and out-of-scope decisions before implementation fan-out.
acceptance_criteria: docs/prd/linux-production-alpha.md is decision-complete and cross-references the authoritative execution direction.

title: Dependency and supply-chain freeze
description: Make Aide reproducible and clear the selected dependency security gate before product work continues.
acceptance_criteria: All direct versions and toolchains are exact, frozen installs reproduce, the seven-day quarantine is enforced, and high/critical audit findings are zero.

title: Upgrade and lock the Electron build toolchain
description:
Execution mode: AFK
Upgrade Node, Bun, Electron, electron-vite, Vite, TypeScript, Vitest, Biome, Playwright, and React Doctor to the approved exact matrix. Migrate configs and rebuild native modules.
acceptance_criteria: Exact toolchain pins install with Bun 1.3.14; Electron 43 loads node-pty; node tests, check, build, and Electron E2E pass.
close_reason: Merged PR #1; exact toolchain lock and Linux gates passed

title: Upgrade and lock managed provider SDKs
description:
Execution mode: AFK
Upgrade the Claude Agent SDK and add its exact runtime peers while preserving structured managed-session behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Claude and Codex fake-provider tests pass, SDK peers are explicit exact dependencies, and startup/approval/input/plan flows remain structured.

title: Upgrade and lock renderer dependencies
description:
Execution mode: AFK
Upgrade React and every direct renderer dependency to the approved exact matrix and remove all semver ranges.
acceptance_criteria: No direct dependency uses a range or mutable tag; renderer tests, accessibility smoke, build, and Electron E2E pass.

title: Enforce frozen installs, dependency policy, and Linux CI
description:
Execution mode: AFK
Add seven-day release-age enforcement, exact-pin verification, frozen installs, high/critical audit gating, pinned GitHub Actions, Dependabot, and protected-main prerequisites.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh Ubuntu CI run passes install, policy, audit, doctor, node tests, check, build, and Electron E2E; required checks can protect main.

title: Workspace, preview, and agent-state convergence
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Converge project-scoped navigation, durable hosted previews, and authoritative managed-session activity. Beads is authoritative. Linear mirror is pending because no Linear connector is available in the execution runtime.
acceptance_criteria: All six child slices pass their ticket-level tests and the repository final gates: bun run test:node, bun run check, bun run build, bun run test:e2e; branch is pushed.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by node, check, build, Electron E2E, relaunch, multi-project, and accessibility smoke gates.

title: Restore the project-scoped workspace navigation contract
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Unify workspace projections used by camera, switcher, overview, sidebar, and shortcuts. Deliver project digit jumps, project-scoped vertical movement, stable persisted ordering, selection repair, and multi-project E2E coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Camera/switcher are active-project scoped; overview/sidebar remain cross-project; Cmd/Ctrl+digit selects a project and restores remembered workspace/surface/pane; activity never reorders navigation; unit and Electron coverage pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by node, check, build, Electron E2E, relaunch, multi-project, and accessibility smoke gates.

title: Synchronize committed workspace snapshots
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Add catalog and surface revisions, typed mutation conflicts, structural broadcasts, and subscribe-before-hydrate renderer reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Structural mutations are serialized and revision checked; committed snapshots fan out with monotonic revision; hydration buffers and replays only newer events; repair handles missing project/workspace/surface/pane and preserves empty workspaces; concurrency/race tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by node, check, build, Electron E2E, relaunch, multi-project, and accessibility smoke gates.

title: Deliver a durable single-tab workspace preview
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Add shared preview contracts, migration 6 storage, a main-process preview manager, secure loopback-only hosted webview, status UI, and relaunch restoration.
acceptance_criteria: ensurePreviewState is idempotent; default tab is created only before initialization; preview persists across full relaunch; only credential-free HTTP(S) loopback URLs up to 2048 chars are accepted; webview partition/security/status/failure tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by node, check, build, Electron E2E, relaunch, multi-project, and accessibility smoke gates.

title: Deliver synchronized multi-tab preview navigation
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Add open/select/close, back/forward/reload, centralized offscreen webview hosting, per-workspace isolation, revision reconciliation, and stale-event rejection.
acceptance_criteria: Tabs preserve browser/runtime state offscreen; workspaces are isolated; active-tab close selects nearest survivor; empty initialized state stays empty; renderer reload and full relaunch restore tabs; event ordering tests and Electron scenarios pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by node, check, build, Electron E2E, relaunch, multi-project, and accessibility smoke gates.

title: Derive live workspace activity from authoritative sessions
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Make ManagedSessionSnapshot the sole source of truth for managed activity; add runtime generation and revision checks and aggregate only coarse fallback-terminal state separately.
acceptance_criteria: No duplicate managed provider projector remains; stale-generation events are ignored; Working and Connecting survive renderer reload/background navigation; versioned subscribe-before-snapshot activity delivery and tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by node, check, build, Electron E2E, relaunch, multi-project, and accessibility smoke gates.

title: Complete T3 sidebar status parity
description:
Execution mode: AFK

Persist visit watermarks; add Plan Ready and unseen completion/error semantics; preserve multi-session tooltips, project rollups, exact-pane navigation, and accessible non-nested controls.
acceptance_criteria: Priority is Error, Approval, Input, Working/Connecting, Plan Ready, Completed, Terminal; Plan Ready is structured only; visibility acknowledgements persist; status controls navigate to owning pane; styling/accessibility and Electron lifecycle tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented and verified by node, check, build, Electron E2E, relaunch, multi-project, and accessibility smoke gates.

title: Phase 3 - Core panes
description: Implement the first real workspace tool surfaces: terminal, git, preview, editor, jobs, logs, and real presets.

title: P3-001 Pane registry
description: Create a central pane type registry and factory so real panes plug into one composition system.
acceptance_criteria: Pane types resolve to renderers and default metadata/state can be created centrally.

title: P3-010 Editor pane renderer
description: Render Monaco as a real editor pane for inspection, light editing, and saving.
acceptance_criteria: Files open, save, and track dirty state.

title: P3-011 Jobs domain model and service
description: Create the workspace-scoped jobs store and service that future provider and notification flows depend on.
acceptance_criteria: Jobs can be created, updated, completed, and failed; job lists are queryable by workspace.
close_reason: Not needed — ManagedAgentPane=chat, activity service=jobs, badges=notifications

title: P3-012 Jobs pane
description: Render the jobs pane so running and recent background work is visible in the workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Running and completed jobs are visible and status is visually obvious.
close_reason: Not needed — ManagedAgentPane=chat, activity service=jobs, badges=notifications

title: P3-002 Terminal session manager
description: Implement workspace-scoped terminal sessions that survive naive renderer lifecycle changes.
acceptance_criteria: Sessions can be created per workspace, reattached by pane, and tracked through process lifecycle.

title: P3-003 Terminal pane renderer
description: Render xterm.js as a real terminal pane with attach/detach and resize handling.
acceptance_criteria: Users can type commands; output streams live; resize does not break the terminal.

title: P3-004 Git service layer
description: Create a workspace-scoped git wrapper service for branch state, file status, and parseable errors.
acceptance_criteria: Branch name, changed files, and staged/unstaged state are available; parseable errors are emitted.

title: P3-005 Git pane renderer
description: Render the git pane as the review and trust surface for changed files.
acceptance_criteria: Changed files are visible; staged/unstaged state is obvious; selecting a file updates the review surface.

title: P3-006 Diff viewer
description: Add a diff surface so the git pane can show meaningful file review context.
acceptance_criteria: File diffs render and large diffs do not freeze obviously.

title: P3-007 Preview target model
description: Define workspace-scoped preview targets and active target selection.
acceptance_criteria: A workspace can store one or more preview targets and mark one active.

title: P3-008 Preview pane renderer
description: Render the preview pane for local runtime URLs with reload support.
acceptance_criteria: Local runtime loads; reload works; users can change the active target.

title: P3-009 Editor file open path
description: Create a file resolver and open-file action so git and chat can jump into files.
acceptance_criteria: File paths open into an editor pane and missing-file errors are handled cleanly.

title: Discover provider models and capabilities at runtime
description: Aide hardcodes Claude and Codex model menus and reasoning controls. Latest T3 Code probes Codex model/list and version-gates Claude Fable 5, Opus 4.8/4.7 while defaulting Claude to Sonnet 5. Static menus inevitably expose unavailable models and miss new ones.
acceptance_criteria: Codex models, reasoning levels, and service tiers come from app-server capabilities; Claude models are version-gated; unsupported saved selections fall back with an explanation; tests cover old/new provider versions and aliases.

title: Keep managed workspace states sticky and show multiple session indicators
description: Managed Claude/Codex statuses can be downgraded by later passive terminal output after a user-input or approval prompt opens, and workspace rows collapse multiple active sessions into a single misleading scalar state. Keep pending input/approval sticky until user input resolves them, and let workspace summaries/sidebar UI carry multiple session activities while preserving aggregated project indicators.
acceptance_criteria: Managed Claude/Codex awaiting-input and pending-approval states remain active across later passive output until the user responds; workspace rows and overview chips can show more than one active session; project indicators remain aggregated by priority.

title: Workspace runtime activity state in sidebar
description: Drive sidebar and overview workspace status from live terminal/agent runtime state instead of the current fake summary overrides, with Claude/Codex-aware activity parsing and project-level aggregation.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace rows show runtime activity such as working, awaiting input, attention, ready, and error; project rows/rail aggregate child workspace state; overview cards show the same activity signals; fake summary overrides are removed for real workspaces; targeted tests and relevant UI/build checks pass

title: Phase 4 - Chat and provider adapter layer
description: Turn the shell into an AI-native product with chat, provider adapters, normalized events, and a job-backed execution pipeline.

title: P4-001 Provider adapter interface
description: Define the shared app-facing provider contract, event model, and capability model before real integrations.
acceptance_criteria: Interface, normalized event types, and capability flags exist in code.

title: P4-010 Provider capability flags
description: Expose explicit capability flags so the UI can adapt to provider differences without hard-coded branches.
acceptance_criteria: UI can react to streaming, approvals, and file-event richness via shared capability flags.
close_reason: Env vars and hardcoded shortcuts sufficient for now

title: P4-013 Workspace default provider selection
description: Allow each workspace to set a preferred default provider.
acceptance_criteria: Prompts use the configured default provider unless the user overrides it.
close_reason: Not needed — ManagedAgentPane=chat, activity service=jobs, badges=notifications

title: P4-014 Approval/attention request UX hook
description: Add a generic attention-needed state so provider tasks can pause for human confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Jobs can enter an attention-needed state and the UI makes it distinct from running or completed.
close_reason: Not needed — ManagedAgentPane=chat, activity service=jobs, badges=notifications

title: Managed provider terminal modes and runtime-backed workspace status
description: Replace transcript-only Claude/Codex sidebar status with managed provider terminal modes, structured runtime status derivation, and t3code-style workspace/project status aggregation.
acceptance_criteria: Terminal pane supports shell/Claude/Codex launch modes; managed Claude/Codex sessions drive workspace status from structured runtime state; fallback shell parsing is limited to coarse live state; sidebar/project/overview use a single derived status resolver with sticky completed-on-unseen behavior; targeted tests, build, and checks pass.
close_reason: Managed terminal modes now drive runtime-backed workspace status with t3code-style priority and sticky completion semantics.

title: P4-002 Provider executable configuration UI
description: Let users configure and validate local provider executable paths.
acceptance_criteria: Users can set provider binaries and receive clear validation errors.
close_reason: Env vars and hardcoded shortcuts sufficient for now

title: P4-003 Chat thread domain model
description: Create a workspace-scoped thread, message, and task model independent of any provider implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Chat thread state persists per workspace and can store messages plus task links.
close_reason: Not needed — ManagedAgentPane=chat, activity service=jobs, badges=notifications

title: P4-004 Chat pane renderer
description: Render the workspace chat pane with transcript, input, and linked job state.
acceptance_criteria: Users can send prompts; transcript renders; pending state is visible.
close_reason: Not needed — ManagedAgentPane=chat, activity service=jobs, badges=notifications

title: P4-005 Claude Code adapter
description: Implement the first real provider adapter using Claude Code for launch, streaming, and completion lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Tasks start successfully; stream events normalize; completion and failure map into jobs.

title: P4-006 Chat-to-job pipeline
description: Connect chat prompts to job creation and provider execution so the shell owns the full task lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: Sending a prompt creates a job; status updates during the run; completed jobs link back to the thread.
close_reason: Not needed — ManagedAgentPane=chat, activity service=jobs, badges=notifications

title: P4-007 Provider command event surfacing
description: Expose provider command planning and execution events in chat, jobs, and logs surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Commands appear with timestamps and state; command history is inspectable for a task.

title: P4-008 File-change surfacing from provider events
description: Connect provider file-change events into the git and editor review flow.
acceptance_criteria: Provider-touched files are identifiable and users can jump from chat/job to file or diff review.
close_reason: Not needed — ManagedAgentPane=chat, activity service=jobs, badges=notifications

title: P4-009 Cancellation and failure handling
description: Handle cancellation, failure states, and retries so bad runs can be stopped and understood.
acceptance_criteria: Cancel ends a job or reports inability clearly; failed jobs are visible and inspectable.

title: Replace unconditional Linux software rendering with a fallback
description: Every Linux launch forces llvmpipe/SwiftShader, disables hardware acceleration, GPU compositing, and the GPU sandbox. This is a major rendering and power regression and weakens sandboxing even on healthy systems.
acceptance_criteria: Hardware acceleration remains enabled by default; a documented flag or detected failure enables software fallback; diagnostics identify the active mode; headless CI remains reliable.

title: Keep newly imported workspaces empty instead of seeding placeholder panes
description: Real imported workspaces were still inheriting the demo fallback pane layout, which made repo-root workspaces open with chat/terminal/git splits instead of an empty shell.
acceptance_criteria: Real non-demo workspaces without a persisted layout render empty with no fabricated pane tabs; demo workspaces keep the seeded fallback layout.

title: Restore bun test as a trustworthy repo-wide gate
description: The default bun test command still fails for repo-level reasons unrelated to the current pane-registry work. It is pulling in the Playwright Electron suite directly, node:sqlite-backed tests still fail under Bun, and project-picker.test.ts still depends on vi.stubEnv in a runtime where it is unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: bun test excludes or delegates Playwright correctly; SQLite-backed tests run under a supported runtime or explicit alternative command; project-picker.test.ts uses an environment-stubbing approach supported by the chosen runner; repo docs/scripts reflect the intended default test command.

title: Keep terminal panes recoverable after shell exit
description: TerminalPane currently closes and deletes the entire pane whenever its PTY exits, including an intentional shell exit. This loses layout context and offers no restart path.
acceptance_criteria: PTY exit leaves the pane and layout intact, reports the exit code, and exposes a restart action that starts a fresh session; headless Electron coverage proves the behavior.

title: Fix top-bar pane creation to use horizontal pane track
description: Top-bar pane creation currently behaves like a weighted split insertion, leaving the previous pane visible as a collapsed strip. Treat new panes as top-level horizontal pane-track targets so the active pane owns the viewport and prior panes move off-canvas instead of shrinking onscreen.
acceptance_criteria: Adding a pane from the top bar makes the new pane the active full-scene pane; prior panes remain reachable by horizontal navigation without staying visible as collapsed slivers.

title: Audit stability and current T3 Code parity
description: Run the application headlessly, establish a verified baseline, compare Aide with the current upstream T3 Code architecture and recent behavior, document required journeys and ranked defects, and create evidence-backed follow-up beads.
acceptance_criteria: A durable audit identifies reproduced failures separately from code risks, records the exact upstream revision, defines must-work journeys and execution order, captures verification results, and files actionable beads for remaining P0/P1 work.

title: Make new panes open near-full-size and remove top-bar layout presets
description: Follow-up fix for pane creation UX. New panes currently default to an even split, and the top-right Columns/Focus/Stack controls should be removed from the top bar entirely.
acceptance_criteria: Adding a pane no longer defaults to a 50/50 split; the new pane opens near-full-size beside the existing pane; the top-bar layout preset controls are removed; build/tests for the affected renderer flow pass.
